Class ConfigurableInventoryProvider

java.lang.Object
io.github.kaivian.klibrary.inventory.impl.ConfigurableInventoryProvider
All Implemented Interfaces:
InventoryHandler, InventoryProvider
public class ConfigurableInventoryProvider extends Object implements InventoryProvider
Config-driven implementation of InventoryProvider that creates inventory GUIs from configuration data.

This provider is the primary mechanism for defining GUIs in YAML or JSON configuration. It supports:

  • MiniMessage-formatted titles with placeholder resolution
  • Configurable inventory size (multiples of 9)
  • Button-to-slot mapping with visibility requirements
  • Open requirements and open actions
  • Optional auto-refresh via the global ticker

Configuration Example

my_menu:
  title: "<gradient:#ff0000:#00ff00>My Menu</gradient>"
  size: 27
  auto-refresh: false
  open-actions:
    - type: sound
      sound: BLOCK_NOTE_BLOCK_PLING
  items:
    info_item:
      slot: 13
      material: BOOK
      name: "<yellow>Information"
      left-click-actions:
        - type: message
          message: "<green>Hello!"

    • ConfigurableInventoryProvider

      public ConfigurableInventoryProvider(String id, String title, int size, boolean autoRefresh, List<Requirement> openRequirements, List<Action> openActions)
      Constructs a new ConfigurableInventoryProvider.
      Parameters:
      id - the unique provider ID
      title - the MiniMessage-formatted inventory title (supports placeholders)
      size - the inventory size (must be a multiple of 9, max 54)
      autoRefresh - whether views from this provider should auto-refresh
      openRequirements - requirements that must be met before the inventory opens
      openActions - actions to execute when the inventory opens

    • createView

      @NotNull public @NotNull InventoryView createView(@NotNull @NotNull InventoryContext context)
      Creates a new InventoryView for the given context.

      Each call should return a fresh view instance. The view's Bukkit inventory is created here, typically with a title parsed from MiniMessage and a size determined by configuration.

      Parses the title with custom placeholder resolution, then creates a new Bukkit inventory with the configured size.

      Specified by:
      createView in interface InventoryProvider
      Parameters:
      context - the inventory context containing player, placeholders, and metadata; must not be null
      Returns:
      a newly created inventory view; never null

    • update

      public void update(@NotNull @NotNull InventoryView view)
      Renders or updates the contents of the given view.

      This method is called:

      • Once immediately after the view is created (initial render)
      • Periodically by the global ticker if InventoryProvider.isAutoRefresh() returns true
      • Manually via InventoryView.refresh()

      Implementations should populate the view's inventory with the appropriate items based on the current context state.

      Iterates all slots and renders visible buttons. Empty slots or slots with hidden buttons are cleared.

      Specified by:
      update in interface InventoryProvider
      Parameters:
      view - the inventory view to update; must not be null

    • onClick

      public void onClick(org.bukkit.event.inventory.InventoryClickEvent event, InventoryContext context)
      Called when a player clicks inside the managed inventory.

      Implementations should typically cancel the event to prevent item theft and then process the click based on the clicked slot and click type.

      Only processes clicks on the top inventory. Delegates to the clicked button if one is present and visible.

      Specified by:
      onClick in interface InventoryHandler
      Parameters:
      event - the Bukkit click event
      context - the inventory context for this session

      Called when the managed inventory is opened for a player.

      This can be used to execute open actions (e.g., playing sounds, sending messages). Default implementation does nothing.

    • onClose

      public void onClose(org.bukkit.event.inventory.InventoryCloseEvent event, InventoryContext context)
      Called when the managed inventory is closed by a player.

      This can be used to perform cleanup, save state, or execute close actions. Default implementation does nothing.

      Note: This is called before the InventoryManager's internal close handling (stack cleanup). Do not call InventoryManager.clear(Player) or InventoryManager.pop(Player) from this handler, as the manager handles stack management automatically.

      Specified by:
      onClose in interface InventoryHandler
      Parameters:
      event - the Bukkit close event
      context - the inventory context for this session

    • isAutoRefresh

      public boolean isAutoRefresh()
      Returns whether this provider's views should be automatically refreshed by the InventoryManager's global ticker.

      When enabled, the manager will call InventoryProvider.update(InventoryView) on all active views from this provider approximately once per second (every 20 ticks). This is useful for dynamic content like timers, live statistics, or animated elements.

      Default implementation returns false.

      Specified by:
      isAutoRefresh in interface InventoryProvider
      Returns:
      true if auto-refresh is enabled; false otherwise
